programs.name: Natural & Health Sciences

courses.title: General Psychology
courses.description: Essence of Psychology, Sensation & Perception, Learning Theories, Memory & Forgetting, Motivation & Emotion, Personality, and Disorders.

courses.title: Geography of Ethiopia and the Horn
courses.description: Geology, Relief, Drainage Systems, Climate, Soils, Wildlife & Vegetation, Population, and Economic Activities.

courses.title: History of Ethiopia and the Horn
courses.description: Nature and Uses of History, Peoples and Cultures, Politics & Economy to 13th C, Solomonic Era, and 16th-18th Century Processes.

courses.title: Logic and Critical Thinking
courses.description: Introducing Philosophy, Basic Concepts of Logic, Logic & Language, Critical Thinking, Informal Fallacies, and Categorical Propositions.

courses.title: Mathematics for Natural Sciences
courses.description: Propositional Logic & Set Theory, Real & Complex Numbers, Functions & Polynomials, and Analytic Geometry (Conic Sections).

courses.title: General Physics
courses.description: Preliminaries & Vectors, Kinematics & Dynamics, Fluid Mechanics, Heat & Thermodynamics, Oscillations & Optics, and Electromagnetism.
